entities.name: Aminodiazine amidation
observations: The supplied compressed reaction representation is not directly RDKit-parseable, but the product connectivity is most consistent with coupling a heteroaryl amine to a carboxylic-acid-derived carbonyl to form an amide.
The first reactant contains a nucleophilic amino nitrogen on a diazine-like heteroaromatic fragment; the second contains a complex carboxylic-acid-derived scaffold with a retained aryl chloride.

entities.name: Amide coupling conditions
observations: Reasonable first-line conditions are HATU or T3P with DIPEA in DMF, NMP, or dichloromethane at 0 °C to room temperature.
Alternatives include EDC·HCl with Oxyma or HOAt and DIPEA/N-methylmorpholine, or conversion of the acid to an acid chloride followed by DIPEA or triethylamine.
